task.title: Constrain scheduling by node architecture and OS using node affinity
task.shortdesc: Ensure pods land on compatible nodes by requiring labels that represent CPU architecture and operating system.

step.cmd: Identify how your cluster labels OS and architecture (commonly "kubernetes.io/os" and "kubernetes.io/arch").
Confirm label values on nodes (for example, "linux" and "amd64") using "kubectl get nodes -L kubernetes.io/os,kubernetes.io/arch".
Add required node affinity rules for OS and architecture under "requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution".
Apply the workload and verify it schedules only onto compatible nodes by checking the assigned node details.
If you run mixed-node pools, add additional terms to support multiple valid combinations as needed.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
